# DenuModi — Affective Telemetry, 2D Mood Check & Circadian Energy Lab
> Interactive client-side affective science utilities built on Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect (Valence x Arousal), PANAS dimensions, and circadian chronobiology.

## Interactive Web Tools
- [2D Circumplex Mood Check & Emotional Energy Analyzer](https://denumodi.github.io/): Real-time 2D affect coordinate plotter, 5-axis radar chart, lexical journal analyzer, and local CSV log.
- [Cognitive Burnout & Stress Load Calculator](https://denumodi.github.io/burnout-load-calculator.html): Evaluates weekly work strain, context-switching residue, and 14-day sleep debt.
- [Circadian Chronotype & 24-Hour Peak Mood Planner](https://denumodi.github.io/circadian-mood-planner.html): Maps analytical peaks, afternoon troughs, and melatonin onset windows.
- [Interactive Box Breathing & HRV Pacer](https://denumodi.github.io/breathing-pacer-tool.html): Live visual respiratory pacer for Box (4-4-4-4), 4-7-8, and 0.1 Hz HRV resonance breathing.
- [72-State Emotion Granularity Wheel](https://denumodi.github.io/emotion-wheel-tool.html): Affective vocabulary differentiator with somatic markers and cognitive reappraisal prompts.

## Research Guides
- [The Circumplex Model of Affect: How Valence and Arousal Define Human Mood States](https://denumodi.github.io/circumplex-model-of-affect-guide.html): Comprehensive guide to James A. Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect, explaining how orthogonal Valence and Arousal axes map human mood states and cognitive performance.
- [Sleep Debt and Emotional Volatility: Quantifying the Prefrontal-Amygdala Disconnect](https://denumodi.github.io/sleep-debt-mood-volatility-science.html): How cumulative sleep restriction below 7 hours impairs ventromedial prefrontal cortex inhibition of the amygdala, increasing mood volatility by up to 60%.
- [Emotional Granularity: Why Naming Exact Mood States Reduces Stress Reactivity by 32%](https://denumodi.github.io/emotional-granularity-productivity.html): Discover the science of emotional granularity and affect labeling. Learn how precise mood vocabulary down-regulates amygdala activity and improves cognitive resilience.
- [Ultradian Rhythms and the 90-Minute Focus Cycle: Managing Afternoon Mood Dips](https://denumodi.github.io/ultradian-rhythms-energy-dips.html): Learn how Nathaniel Kleitman's Basic Rest-Activity Cycle (BRAC) governs 90-minute ultradian focus waves and why ignoring recovery troughs triggers afternoon mood crashes.
- [Caffeine Pharmacokinetics, Adenosine Rebound, and Late-Day Mood Crashes](https://denumodi.github.io/caffeine-half-life-anxiety-curve.html): Quantitative analysis of caffeine absorption, CYP1A2 half-life decay, adenosine receptor antagonism, and how stimulant timing drives afternoon anxiety or lethargy.
- [Cognitive Residue and Attention Fragmentation: How Notification Load Alters Baseline Mood](https://denumodi.github.io/digital-context-switching-fatigue.html): Explore Sophie Leroy's Attention Residue theory and why rapid digital context-switching elevates cortisol, drains working memory, and degrades workplace mood.
- [Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia and Paced Breathing: Mechanics of Rapid Mood Down-Regulation](https://denumodi.github.io/autonomic-breathing-hrv-regulation.html): How controlled respiration modulates the vagus nerve, baroreflex sensitivity, and Heart Rate Variability (HRV) to calm acute stress in under two minutes.
- [Chronotype Alignment: Matching Analytical and Creative Tasks to Circadian Mood Peaks](https://denumodi.github.io/chronotype-alignment-work-schedule.html): How PER3 clock genes determine morning lark vs. evening owl chronotypes, and how scheduling analytical vs. creative tasks around circadian peaks boosts mood.
- [Structured Affective Journaling vs. Rumination: Evidence-Based Protocols for Mental Clarity](https://denumodi.github.io/cognitive-reframing-journaling-methods.html): Why unstructured venting can reinforce negative mood loops, and how cognitive reappraisal and linguistic self-distancing restore emotional clarity.
- [Subclinical Dehydration and Mood Disturbance: How 1.5% Fluid Loss Impacts Alertness and Tension](https://denumodi.github.io/hydration-electrolytes-cognitive-mood.html): Clinical evidence showing how mild 1.5% dehydration increases perceived task difficulty, fatigue, and tension headaches long before conscious thirst appears.
- [Morning Lux Exposure, Melanopsin Signaling, and Seasonal Mood Stability](https://denumodi.github.io/sunlight-lux-serotonin-circadian-anchor.html): Why indoor office lighting (300 lux) fails to anchor the circadian pacemaker, and how 10,000 lux of outdoor morning light elevates daytime mood and sleep quality.
- [Occupational Burnout vs. Acute Fatigue: Objective Behavioral Markers and Recovery Timelines](https://denumodi.github.io/workplace-burnout-recovery-metrics.html): Learn how to distinguish short-term work fatigue from multi-week occupational burnout using behavioral telemetry, sleep architecture, and recovery benchmarks.
